title: Live Cattle Futures Little Changed
text:
Live Cattle Futures Little Changed
August live cattle is trading at 110.55, up 0.15 cents/lb. October live cattle is trading at 109.22, down 0.25 cents/lb. December live cattle is trading at 110.52, down 0.25 cents/lb.
Live cattle futures are trading mixed just after the open Wednesday.
Market chatter weather and cattle supplies for the third quarter is making the rounds.
Trading is expected to be very choppy. The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) monthly cattle on feed and cold storage reports are due out Friday at 3:00 p.m. ET.
